summary: Pin sits in a bushy gap between apartment blocks; no room for a van.

drivers.seclusion: Hemmed in by apartment blocks on three sides, balconies overlook the spot.
drivers.access_and_room: Narrow drive from the NW ends in scrub at the ring; no clear pull-out or tracks.
drivers.traffic: Quiet inner-city lane and cul-de-sac nearby; low traffic.
drivers.convention: Residential apartment area; no sign of overnight stays.

flags: Low-lying: about 2.5 m elevation, Brisbane River 295 m away
sun_shade: Dense tree canopy and tall buildings shade it most of the day.
cannot_judge: Whether the drive is private to the apartments
